One move. Epic chaos.

20 WORLDS  /  600 PUZZLES

A physics puzzle game where every level is a machine waiting for its missing piece. Place it, tap GO, and watch dominoes topple, springs launch and marbles race into the golden core.

Free to play Plays offline No account needed Android 7.0+

How to play

No timers, no twitch reflexes — just one smart placement and a satisfying chain reaction.

1

Choose a piece

Pick a tool from the tray: ramp, platform, spring, bumper, magnet, domino, lever and more.

2

Drag it into the scene

A translucent preview follows your finger. Place it anywhere it fits — there are no hidden snap points.

3

Tap GO

Real physics takes over. Watch the chain play out and guide the marble into the golden core.

4

Adjust and retry

Missed? Retry keeps your last placement so you can nudge it and try again instantly.

Screenshots

Bright, hand-crafted worlds built around a real 2D physics engine.

Your toolbox

Every tool behaves with real physics. Learn them in the Tool guide, complete with live demonstrations.

RampAngle the marble’s path and build speed.
PlatformBridge gaps and give the chain a place to land.
SpringLaunch objects through the air — flip it to change direction.
BumperBounce the marble off at a sharp new angle.
MagnetPull the marble toward it to bend its trajectory.
DominoStart or extend a toppling cascade.
LeverTip, swing and redirect with balance and momentum.
SwitchOpen gates and trigger linked machines.

20 worlds to master

The first five levels teach the basics. Worlds 1–3 need one piece; from World 4 you place two essential pieces to connect multi-machine cascades. Every world and level is open from the start.

Features

600 validated puzzles

Every level is verified to be solvable in the real physics engine, and every placed piece matters.

Optional hints

Stuck? Reveal the right piece and a translucent preview of where it goes.

Tool guide

Descriptions and live mini-demos for every tool and scene object, with a link to a level that uses it.

Play anywhere

Fully playable offline. Progress saves automatically on your device.

Comfort settings

Reduced motion, reduced effects, haptics, graphics quality, plus separate music and sound volume.

Original art & sound

Hand-crafted layered artwork and newly synthesised audio for a bright, playful feel.

Made by Syntora Labs

Chain Chaos is an independent game built with Flutter and a real-time 2D physics engine. Questions or feedback? We’d love to hear from you at support.syntoralabs@gmail.com.
